lede: The day's one genuinely crossed story is Serbia's parliamentary election, the only item to surface on two feeds at once. It sits second on Wikipedia with 242,482 views and leads Polymarket, where the market on Aleksandar Vucic winning the most seats settled at 0.05 percent yes after $4.48 million in total volume. Brazil's general election edged just ahead on Wikipedia with 271,783 views, and Mastodon posts reported both outcomes. Hacker News looked elsewhere, leading with a chart of the US wage share of gross domestic income at a 75 year low.

throughlines.title: Will Aleksandar Vučić – United Serbia win the most seats in the 2026 Serbian parliamentary election?
throughlines.gist: Serbia's parliamentary election is the only story on two feeds at once: second on Wikipedia and first on Polymarket, where the Vucic market settled near zero percent yes.

throughlines.gist: A FRED chart showing the US wage share of gross domestic income at a 75 year low led Hacker News with 69 points and 26 comments.
